verdict.rationale: Evidence repeatedly references a lockfile (frozen-lockfile in CI, lockfile-only installs, no lockfile gymnastics) confirming pnpm ships a lockfile that's tracked in version control and used deterministically, which implies a text-based diffable artifact, but no citation explicitly documents the lockfile's YAML/text format or its diff-friendliness for agents. Missing for 10: explicit docs describing the lockfile format (pnpm-lock.yaml) as human-readable/YAML, guidance on diffing/parsing it, and any agent-specific tooling or schema reference.
